title: Guesthouse Loft | East Nashville
description:
Welcome to your stylish retreat in Cleveland Park, East Nashville! 

This bright and airy space welcomes you with abundant natural light and a spacious layout, a full kitchen, washer & dryer, king-sized bed, and smart TV. Plus you'll have a private entrance and a parking spot.

Whether you're planning an extended stay or a weekend getaway, this Airbnb offers the ideal blend of comfort and style. Book now for an unforgettable experience in Music City!

The space
Our loft apartment is a large space - about 900 square feet. There is Wi-fi and a smart TV available to guests. Each room (living & loft) have their own AC/heat unit. 

You'll have a living room, dining area with a bench, full kitchen, and full bathroom. 

The kitchen has a side-by-side refrigerator/freezer under the countertop, range, oven, and garbage disposal. There is no dishwasher.

Please note: the upstairs loft bedroom has low ceilings at just under 6’. If you are uncomfortable in tight spaces or have a history of claustrophobia, please consider booking a different place. The ceilings are not standard height in the loft, but makes for a cozy little nook bedroom :)

Guest access
You can access the home from the alley off of Marie St. You have your own entrance and can park in the gravel at the front door. 

There is a smart keypad and you will have a custom code sent to you prior to check-in.

Other things to note
Please see note about the loft ceiling height. This is a back house unit and we live in the front house full-time.

This house is a short 6 min Uber to Broadway.
